scope: Catalog store operations wait for an I/O admission only until their caller's deadline; the 3-second per-operation cap starts at admission, so an operation that queued may hold its admission up to 3 s after admission. Nation city reads queued for the KMA store's admissions are then late rather than failed. The warnings API waits for another request's latest-bulletin walk only until its own deadline and answers from recent memory. Found in the SR-6 rehearsal. No deployment or production mutation.
